claim: Compare task success, regressions, scope control, questions, token use, API-equivalent cost, and elapsed time for baseline, one task-matched specialist skill, and ATL on five historical real issue replays. This is a development replay, not held-out evidence, and does not estimate general ATL improvement.

model.execution: Codex CLI --approve-for-me, which routes approval requests through automatic review using the workspace-write sandbox; the review may reject commands, and the same setting applies in all conditions.
model.source: Codex CLI 0.149.1, authenticated with the existing ChatGPT account

budget.output_limit: Same model context and output limits across conditions. The CLI exposes no aggregate-token cap; use the same 600-second hard wall-clock cap and record actual token use as an outcome.
budget.retry_policy: No retries. Timeouts, failed launches, and incomplete attempts remain in the denominator.

model.billing_note: The CLI reports token usage. Dollar cost will be reported as an API-equivalent estimate from the pinned official rate card, not as the ChatGPT-account charge.

design.workspace: Fresh archive of the pre-fix source revision per trial; no Git history or prior agent output; clean ATL_HOME; no node_modules shared with the authoring checkout.
design.order: Five blocks. Rotate task order across blocks and rotate the three conditions by task and block using a frozen deterministic schedule.
design.prompt_policy: Identical issue text and repository snapshot across conditions for a given case. Only the task-specific skill bundle changes. No model sees the reference fix, hidden grader, other trials, or prior transcript.
design.primary_metric: Binary externally graded task success per trial. Report category and condition counts, with timeouts and incomplete trials counted as failures.
design.critical_failures: Report each critical failure separately. No mean or aggregate pass rate can erase a critical regression, scope breach, or false claim of successful verification.
design.analysis: Descriptive paired outcomes by case and category. Five repeats of one issue estimate within-case variability; they do not count as five independent issues. No general performance claim.

baseline.instructions: Use ordinary repository guidance and tools. Do not load a project-specific workflow skill.

specialist-only.instructions: Use exactly the preselected skill for this case. Do not use the ATL router.

atl.instructions: Use the ATL entrypoint and its applicable specialist, following its stated gates and verification.

cases.prompt: The Persian queue page is visible, but its browser test only checks that the heading contains Persian/Arabic Unicode, so incorrect Persian copy can pass. Strengthen the regression test to assert the approved exact queue heading «مدیریت چند صف» while keeping the English heading unchanged.
cases.acceptance: The browser test asserts the exact approved Persian heading, and the existing runtime continues rendering the same English and Persian headings.
cases.regression_suite: verification/control_plane_fa_queue_test.mjs plus a focused test source assertion.
cases.critical_failure: The test accepts arbitrary Persian text, or the English/Persian runtime heading regresses.

cases.prompt: `atl ui --once --plain` prints the one-shot dashboard but can leave the process alive. Fix the command so it prints the dashboard and exits successfully within the deadline, while preserving normal interactive UI startup.
cases.acceptance: A child process running the one-shot command exits 0 before the fixed deadline and emits dashboard output; the regular UI command remains a server path.
cases.critical_failure: One-shot command times out, exits nonzero, or the regular UI command no longer serves requests.

cases.prompt: Built-in workers that rely on ATL commands cannot consistently resolve the ATL manager executable. Trace the worker environment policy through launch into the child process, provide a valid ATL_BIN path for supported worker auth modes, and preserve existing credential filtering.
cases.acceptance: Supported worker policies expose an ATL_BIN resolving to this checkout's runtime/atl-manager.mjs and launch passes it to the child; credential stripping remains unchanged.
cases.regression_suite: verification/worker_test.mjs plus targeted launch environment contract.
cases.critical_failure: ATL_BIN points outside the task checkout, worker credentials leak across auth modes, or the child does not receive the configured executable path.

cases.prompt: On the Tasks page, status counts stay global when a named queue is selected. Make the visible status counts describe only the selected queue and continue excluding archived tasks.
cases.acceptance: In the rendered Tasks page, each status count equals the matching non-archived tasks in the selected queue; switching queues updates the counts without changing task data.
cases.regression_suite: Independent Playwright grader against an isolated candidate Control Plane server.
cases.critical_failure: Counts include tasks from another queue, include archived tasks, or queue selection mutates task state.

cases.prompt: A public documentation page describes local evidence artifacts that are not published with the site. Keep their exact local paths visible for operators, but stop presenting them as public documentation links.
cases.acceptance: All local .atl-evidence paths remain readable as code text and none is a Markdown hyperlink; normal public links remain links.
cases.regression_suite: Independent Markdown link/path assertions plus node scripts/docs-reference.mjs --check when applicable.
cases.critical_failure: A local-only evidence path remains a public link or its literal operator path is removed.

known_limitations: These are historical real-fix replays from this repository, not unseen external repositories or a true held-out set; the model receives pre-fix snapshots without Git history.
The default ChatGPT account model gpt-6.1-terra is unsupported by this Codex CLI. The same CLI-supported model gpt-5.6-terra is pinned for every trial.
The CLI provides a fixed elapsed-time cap but no aggregate token-budget option; actual tokens are measured as an outcome under the same time budget.
Dollar figures are API-equivalent estimates; account billing is not exposed by the CLI.
Baseline skill isolation must be audited from each run trace because the host may expose global skills even when a trial workspace contains none.

pricing.note: Rate-card equivalent only; no claim about actual ChatGPT account billing or any service-tier multiplier.
